column3: Kuroneko Route · A Brief Period of Respite
And with that, I focused on continuing my work.
We're home～!
Eh?
Eh, did someone come home?
Sis, isn't that a pair of shoes that we've never seen before?
Ah, you're right.
Ruri-nee～, did someone come over～?
Could it be... that they're Kuroneko's sisters!?
Ah.
Ah...
...Pardon the intrusion.
Yes, we're glad to have you.
...Looks like a very energetic and cute child, just like a mini version of Kuroneko. She should still be in kindergarten, I think.
...Woah!
This lively child should still be in elementary school... right? She looks really taken aback.
Ruri-nee's boyfriend-----------!
Ehh!?
Wow---! She really got a boyfriend!!
W-W-Wha...
I've been thinking something's amiss recently!
Saying "go out and play today", "three hours... leaving the room will let you avoid being cursed by the Demon King to turn into tonight's dinner"... stuff
like that!
Sneaky peeky sneaky peeky～
So that's what's been going on... Ehehe～
I-It's not like that! You're both mistaken!
I'm not her boyfriend!
Eh? Is that so?
Yeah, I'm Kousaka Kyousuke. Uhh, I'm in the same club as your sister, pleased to meet you.
Woah! I've heard of that name before!
Eh?
So you're the brother of that 'bitch' who always quarrels with Ruri-nee on the phone, right!?
Yeah, that's me, no doubt about it.
...Kirino. You're being remembered by Kuroneko's sisters in a very remarkable way, you know?
Well... can I call you the bitch's brother?
Not good at all! ...Call me something else.
Ehh～? Well then...
Big brother.
Eh?
Big brother～
A-Ahh...
Ehehe.
How cute! She's completely different from my own sister.
I mustn't bring Kirino to this house, because something bad will happen...
I'll just call you Kousaka-kun for now.
Yeah, that will do.
Hey, hey, Kousaka-kun.
Hmm? What is it?
...This kid is being over-familiar.
Will you get married to Ruri-nee?
*choke*
H-How is that possible! I said I'm not her boyfriend already, didn't I?
Eh～? But...
Ruri-nee did mention it before, I think she said it should be you, Kousaka-kun, right?
H-How was it said?
...Hmph... don't take me for a fool. I, too, have a guy... that has formed a 'contract' with me.
His name in this world is 'Kyousuke'. While I was still the Black Beast in the past, he's a ferocious beast that once paired with me...
What did that fool tell her own sisters...?
Initially I assumed that boyfriend in her mind was 2D...
You're really too cruel.
I didn't think you'd really exist! It really took me by surprise! S-S-So then! What was that 'contract'... what was it all about? Hyah～①
I don't know what you're imagining, but it's all a misunderstanding!
Then what was that 'contract' all about?
...I-I don't know.
It's a kiss, right?
T-This kid---
W-What was the ruckus all about... you---two...
Ah, she petrified.
T-This... what's the meaning of this.
...It is as you see.
Hu... Kukuku... You two... I said I allowed you two to play outdoors until evening, didn't I? Why are you two here?
But it's hot outside, isn't it～?
Isn't it～?
Hmm... is that all you have... to say?
Oh no! Ruri-nee is actually angry... Please save us, Kousaka-kun!
Please save us～ Big brother～
D-Don't use me as a shield!
Oh my.. You seem to be getting along with them pretty well.
...Please think of something to calm her down, she's your elder sister, right?
All right, leave it to me!
I have a question for Ruri-nee!
...What?
Did Ruri-nee take a bath with the intention to form a 'contract' with Kousaka-kun?
Wh...
Ehehe, we disturbed you two unknowingly--- and that's why you're angry!
Unbelievable! This is adding fuel to the fire!
...Hmph.
Ku-Kuroneko...?
I'm sorry about this, senpai. It seems like I'll have to excuse myself again.
I have no choice but to teach my sister a lesson right now.
...G-Go ahead.
Noooooooooo～～!
An angered sister Kuroneko is truly terrifying.
